about_the_game:
This is a free demo of Cycle of Struggle: Ardengrad — a visual novel about politics, revolution, and personal choices in an alternate-world country.

WHAT’S INCLUDED IN THE DEMO:

  • Part of the prologue (approximately 1–2 hours of gameplay)

  • Introduction to the main protagonist and key characters

  • A glimpse into student life in Ardengrad: lectures, conversations, and early political discussions

  • Meet the main female characters: Katya, Anya, Nadya, and Masha

  • Early dialogues, initial choices, and the chance to influence how the girls perceive you

  • Original soundtrack, character sprites, CGs, and backgrounds

WHAT IS THE VISUAL NOVEL ABOUT?

You are a university student who accidentally ends up joining a political science club in the capital city of Ardena.

At first glance, it seems like an ordinary campus experience — but tension is rising in the country, and your actions are starting to carry real weight.

THE HEROINES:

  • Katya – A fiery communarist, believing in the power of the people and radical change.

  • Anya – A careful observer, hesitant to make rash decisions, always weighing every step.

  • Nadya – A hardened national syndicalist, ready to fight in a world where survival is not guaranteed.

  • Masha – A sincere monarchist, torn between tradition, duty, and her own path in the chaos of revolution.

THE DEMO DOES NOT INCLUDE:

  • Full character arc development

  • Romantic/intimate scenes (only early groundwork for future routes)

  • Civil war episodes (these will appear in the full version)

The demo is an invitation to the world of Ardena.
Get to know the heroines, immerse yourself in the atmosphere of student life, and make your first meaningful choices on the path to a much greater story.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: Core2Duo 2.4Ghz
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 256M
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound card

short_description: Cycle of Struggle: Ardengrad – a demo version of a visual novel about a nation on the brink of revolution. Four heroines, four ideologies, one choice: take a stand or watch from the sidelines, save Ardena or let it fall into chaos. Your decisions will shape its fate.
